pages.title: Phage Lab
pages.text: Plates of bacteria in a sealed cabinet, and a pipette of viruses: count the clear spots where the phages burst through.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the multiplicity of infection (phages per cell) and the time. The share of cells hit is 1 − e^(−MOI) and each bursts after its latent period; both must reach the recipe's share. Over 15 phages a cell they burst the cells from outside, for nothing.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bacteriophage, Recombinant DNA.
